activityVerification.evidence: The official submission page is labelled Rolling Admissions 2026 and states a 14-business-day response target. Official featured-artist audio and station releases were uploaded through May 2026, and official blog posts are dated June 5 and June 8, 2026. The site advertises a 24/7 online radio station and current Roku, Firestick and app distribution.

genreFitEvidence: The official form accepts Electronic, Reggae / Dancehall, World / Afrobeats, Experimental, Hip-Hop / Rap, R&B / Soul, Pop and multiple other genres.
Variety Vibes describes itself as an all-genre global platform for independent and established artists.
MarcsMusic electronic, reggae, bass, world-fusion, hip-hop-adjacent and crossover releases have direct published genre matches, subject to human content and agreement review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is current, first-party, worldwide-facing and all-genre, but it requires uploads and legally binding rights and promotional-use agreements, includes a JavaScript-dependent external agreement that was not passively reviewable, and sits beside separately priced promotional services. Human legal, rights, asset, AI-policy and payment-boundary review is mandatory.
